title: Estimating label quality and errors in semantic segmentation data via any model
mechanism: Image label-quality score = soft-minimum of out-of-sample likelihood of each pixel's given class (cleanlab segmentation, built on confident learning doi:10.1613/jair.1.12125).
adaptation: Run cleanlab find_label_issues on the same out-of-fold softmax maps as the ensemble-ranking arm; zero extra training; standard baseline for the benchmark's label audit.
min_experiment: Arm: cleanlab ranking. Baseline: ensemble ranking (Nogueira-style). Metric: precision at 24 vs audit-flagged cells. Kill: none, kept as baseline row; drop from training arms if precision below ensemble ranking.
evidence: R: soft-min score best of 7 for detecting mislabeled images in SYNTHIA with DeepLabV3+/FPN. Nogueira 2026 measured cleanlab tau 0.17, worst on deletions.
